name: push-pottaa
description: Quiet, optional Malayalam Therivili notifications for developer actions in VS Code.

pushPottaa.enabled.description: Show a small VS Code notification after supported developer actions.

pushPottaa.voice.description: Read the message aloud using the operating system voice. Off by default.

pushPottaa.deployCommands.description: Command phrases treated as deployments. Match is case-insensitive.

pushPottaa.successEvents.description: Show a Therivili message after successful Git push, pull, PR, deployment, test, or build commands.
